selection.basis: The completed full q-skeleton leaves q=0.90 unresolved and q=0.95 ceiling-compatible. q=0.85 is retained as the finite-side guard because its two adjacent-size point crossings are broad and inconsistent.
selection.why_more_clusters_first: The discovery used only five independent seed trajectories and produced widespread sign instability and multiple crossings. Twenty fresh clusters distinguish sampling fluctuation from stable topology before any q midpoint is added.
selection.why_these_p_values: The grid covers the q=0.85 L9/L11 crossing region near 0.36 and L7/L9 crossing region near 0.48, retains high-p sentinels, and adds guards at 0.425 and 0.47.
selection.claim_boundary: This wave is analyzed independently from the discovery and cannot itself establish q_c. A q=0.925 midpoint is permitted only after the q=0.90 and q=0.95 endpoint classifications pass the registered 90% gates.
